notes.title: The demo(v1.1.3) for "Orcs Will Never Be Slaves" just got an update!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185588/f02c606e0602e85b9915dcbf707504b549659cbd.png"]

1."Flurry Attack" now charges with basic attacks

2."Flurry Attack" enhance option : Healing now triggers on crits

3.Redesigned "Flurry Attack" for Sword & Shield

4.Redesigned "Flurry Attack" for Hammer

5.Greatly increased rage gain - use your Musou Attack more often!

6.Redesigned Musou Attack charge mechanic

7.Redesigned Musou Attack channeling mechanic

8.Redesigned "Guardian Shield" effect & its enhance option

9.Redesigned "Revenge Shield" effect & its enhance option

10.Redesigned "Storm Hammer" effect & its enhance option

11.Adjusted Skeleton Army spawn rate

12.Improved Skeleton AI positioning

13.Improved bow basic attack feel

14.Nerfed negative affix "Soul Barrage"

15.Fixed several bugs

notes.title: The demo(v1.1.2) for "Orcs Will Never Be Slaves" just got an update!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185588/d81ab6bff8842023f8ca2447f0503dccff8fc4b9.png"]
Update details are as follows:
1.Added descriptions for Flurry and Musou mechanics.

2.Adjusted Flurry activation chance.

3.Tuned starting Rage value.

4.First enhancement now always grants Dash Attack expansion.

5.Optimized attack rhythm for the Mecha Guard.

6.Improved attack timing for the Rampage Boar.

7.Enhanced support for several third-party controller brands.

8.Fix some bugs.

notes.title: The demo(v1.1.1) for "Orcs Will Never Be Slaves" just got an update!
notes.notes:
Update details are as follows:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185588/3210b59e6b21a9e8af59c79b542eced3d444ba17.png
1.Adjusted monster HP scaling to be more balanced.
2.Adjusted the spawn maps for Slimes and Jackalmen.
3.Improved the positioning logic for Skeletons.
4.Increased the charging speed of Revenge Shield's Musou Attack.
5.Added a turning function during Revenge Shield's Musou Attack.
6.Increased the spawn rate of Musou Attack-related enhancement options.
7.Restructured weapon-specific enhancement options.
8.Added new enhancement options related to basic attack scaling.
9.Added a new set of enhancement options related to potions.
10.Adjusted the dash impact mechanics.
11.Adjusted the dash frenzy mechanics.
12.Fixed some bugs

notes.title: The demo(v1.1.0) for "Orcs Will Never Be Slaves" just got an update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185588/ee4098f2cf759199efe51cd684800a9adb53f9b9.png
Update details are as follows:

1.Redesigned the combat flow and adjusted the duration of each battle to 15 minutes.
2.Redesigned the normal attack combos for each weapon.
3.Created unique Flurry Attacks for each type of weapon.
4.Redesigned the Rage Skills (Musou Attacks) for each weapon.
5.Revised the selection rules for enhancement options.
6.Significantly increased the number of enhancement options.
7.Redesigned the pause menu to now display acquired enhancement options.
8.Redesigned the control scheme for gamepads.
9.The base dash count is now 2, with a more visible indicator on the character.
10.Adjusted monster parameters and added hit reactions for monsters.
11.Tweaked the parameters of negative affix.
12.Optimized the map layout.
13.Improved audio performance.
14.Updated the game’s logo.
15.Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: The demo(v1.0.4) for "Orcs Will Never Be Slaves" just got an update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185588/9a92805dbeaf9a342a8977c2361d107eeacae5d2.png
Update details are as follows:
1.Increased the number of in-combat level-ups.
2.Adjusted the select times for some Enhance options.
3.Optimized the attack rhythm for bows and warhammers to make it smoother.
4.Tweaked the attack hitbox for Slime monsters for better accuracy.
5.Certain monsters will no longer be knocked back when forced to move.
6.Fixed several bugs.

notes.title: The demo for "Orcs Will Never Be Slaves" just got an update!
notes.notes:
Update details are as follows:
1.Implemented an auto-attack feature. Just hold down the left mouse button or the attack button on your controller to automatically attack.
2.Revenge Shield's bounce rules Adjustment, it now prefers non-summoned units.
3.Storm Hammer has been redesigned, each hit on an enemy now deals increased damage.
4.Enhance : Arrows piercing through enemies now give double rage.
5.Enhance : You get more rage when you take hits.
6.Reduce the duration of slime‘s venom.
7.Fixed the angle for auto-targeting in controller mode.
8.Swapped out the mouse cursor texture.
9.fix some other bugs
